fields.label: Conversation IDs
fields.help: Comma-separated conversation IDs to keep warm — run `torana conversations` to list them. Empty means observe only. Warming everything loses money: refreshing only pays for a bounded window, so choose the conversations you are actually coming back to.

fields.label: Warm For (minutes)
fields.help: How long after the last real turn to keep refreshing. 0 relies on the break-even refresh count alone. Beyond roughly 45 minutes on a 5-minute cache tier, refreshing costs more than accepting the miss.

fields.label: Refresh Interval Override (seconds)
fields.help: 0 uses the provider's configured cadence (80% of its shortest cache lifetime). An interval at or beyond that lifetime is rejected, since the refresh would always arrive after the entry had expired.
